drhp.business: DMCL is engaged in the production, curation, creation, conversion, procurement, buying, selling and distribution of multimedia content i.e. Digital News, Videos, Documentaries and Photo Stories, distributed and aggregated in India and abroad through existing or emerging modes of distribution. The Company discontinued its print Newspaper division in October 2019 and now operates solely as a Digital Media business under the DNA brand, also offering content syndication through a dedicated content-licensing division.

litigation.note: During FY2025-26 the Company received a Show Cause Notice (as a co-noticee) dated 12 February 2026 from SEBI in the matter of Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited, alleging violation of SEBI PFUTP Regulations/SEBI Act in respect of certain business transactions; the Company has filed a settlement application under the SEBI (Settlement Proceedings) Regulations, 2018, which is under consideration — read in the Corporate Overview/Board's Report disclosures section.

demand_drivers.title: Mdna (RHP)
demand_drivers.body:
- Management notes a decline in key operating metrics, including Monthly Active Users (MAUs) and page views, prompting the revival of the IDPL distribution arrangement to optimize monetization.
- Revenue from operations (Syndication Income of the Digital Media business) decreased due to a decline in overall traffic during the year.
- Industry-wide, digital advertising is expected to keep gaining share of total ad revenues (management cites digital media as the largest and fastest-growing M&E segment) as a structural demand tailwind for digital-content businesses.
- Management flags continuing capital-expenditure pressure industry-wide from AI-led adtech, cloud-rendering pipelines and predictive personalization investment needed to remain competitive.

risks.title: Risks (RHP)
risks.body:
- The Company observed a decline in Monthly Active Users (MAUs) and page views, and revenue from operations fell 51% YoY; management responded by re-entering a revenue-sharing arrangement with Indiadotcom Digital Private Limited (IDPL) under which IDPL takes a 15% share of digital-asset revenue, concentrating distribution and monetization dependency in one related-party counterparty.
- The Company received a Show Cause Notice (as a co-noticee) from SEBI dated 12 February 2026 in the matter of Zee Entertainment Enterprises Limited, alleging violation of SEBI PFUTP Regulations/SEBI Act; a settlement application is under consideration, an unresolved regulatory matter.
- A Corporate Guarantee from Zee Media Corporation Limited (ZMCL) on the Company's non-convertible debentures was invoked and had to be settled via transfer of Identified Trademarks and a cash payment, indicating the Company's reliance on group-entity guarantees to meet debt obligations.
- The Company's inter-corporate deposits with Veena Investments Private Limited (VIPL) and VIPL's NCRPS holding in the Company were the subject of arbitration; a Board-approved Scheme of Reduction to net these off is still pending regulatory approval, leaving the capital structure unsettled.
- Management notes that legacy, ad-exposed models like Linear Television face continuous pressure and sharp drops in ad volume as spending shifts to digital, a structural risk for any business still exposed to non-digital or syndication-based monetization models.
- Management flags potential changes in data-privacy governance, stricter content regulations and digital censorship as risks that could alter operational dynamics for media/digital-content platforms such as the Company.
- Management flags the growth of generative AI-driven fake news, deepfakes and synthetic replication as an industry risk requiring investment in fact-checking and content-authentication safeguards, relevant to a digital news/content distributor.
- Management flags advanced data breaches, cloud-infrastructure hacking and ransomware attacks as threats to user data privacy and content-distribution network integrity as digital consumption scales.

strategy.title: Strategies (RHP)
strategy.body:
- Continue to concentrate on expanding its Digital Platforms, maintaining a sharp focus on cost optimization and revenue maximization to navigate a challenging fiscal environment.
- Optimize monetization and distribution of digital properties by reviving the revenue-sharing distribution arrangement with Indiadotcom Digital Private Limited (IDPL), which brings demonstrated expertise, operational capabilities and market presence in digital media distribution and advertising operations.
